entries.description: Fleshed out spec with design decisions table (form=modal, API=BackofficeUserCreationService, collision=reject, magic-link=IsProvisioned flag), per-session step lists, audit plan, risk notes.

Applied 6 design fixes from verification round 1: (1) audit emission ordering made unambiguous inside transaction; (2) IsProvisioned default flipped to true, opt-in false for admin INSERT; (3) email-uniqueness via existing unique index + DbUpdateException catch; (4) UAT-5 CrossOrgMonitor denial added; (5) controller authorization policy named (actor in {SystemAdmin, CrossOrgUserAdmin, UserAdmin}); (6) magic-link enqueue post-commit failure documented with mitigation.
Round 2 cross-provider verification via opus: VERIFIED
